habits.name: Daily Planning
habits.description: Likha hua top-3 goals list exist karta hai before 9 AM daily.
habits.criteria: Likha hua top-3 goals list exist karta hai before 9 AM daily.

habits.name: Deep Work
habits.description: Phone doosre room mein hai during every study block.
habits.criteria: Phone doosre room mein hai during every study block.

habits.name: Night Review
habits.description: 3-question review likha gaya har raat sone se pehle.
habits.criteria: 3-question review likha gaya har raat sone se pehle.

habits.name: Self-Discipline
habits.description: Ek bhi "mann nahi kar raha" excuse pe task skip nahi kiya.
habits.criteria: Ek bhi "mann nahi kar raha" excuse pe task skip nahi kiya.

habits.name: Consistency
habits.description: Same core tasks daily bina miss kiye.
habits.criteria: Same core tasks daily bina miss kiye.

habits.name: Time Management
habits.description: Din ke study blocks ko exact clock time assign kiya.
habits.criteria: Din ke study blocks ko exact clock time assign kiya.

habits.name: Goal Setting
habits.description: Weekly goal likha hai aur roz uske against progress check ho raha hai.
habits.criteria: Weekly goal likha hai aur roz uske against progress check ho raha hai.

habits.name: Top 3 Priorities
habits.description: Roz ke 3 goals mein se sabse important ek highlight kiya.
habits.criteria: Roz ke 3 goals mein se sabse important ek highlight kiya.

habits.name: Task Management
habits.description: Din ke saare tasks (study + non-study) ek jagah list kiye.
habits.criteria: Din ke saare tasks (study + non-study) ek jagah list kiye.

habits.name: Single-tasking
habits.description: Ek block mein sirf ek subject/topic, switching nahi.
habits.criteria: Ek block mein sirf ek subject/topic, switching nahi.

habits.name: Focus & Concentration
habits.description: Block ke beech mein koi voluntary break/check nahi (sirf planned breaks).
habits.criteria: Block ke beech mein koi voluntary break/check nahi (sirf planned breaks).

habits.name: Distraction Control
habits.description: Study space se phone/notifications/clutter hata ke start kiya.
habits.criteria: Study space se phone/notifications/clutter hata ke start kiya.

habits.name: Execution
habits.description: Jo plan kiya wahi din mein actually kiya (plan-do gap zero).
habits.criteria: Jo plan kiya wahi din mein actually kiya (plan-do gap zero).

habits.name: Finish Tasks
habits.description: Shuru kiya har task usi din complete kiya, adhoora nahi chhoda.
habits.criteria: Shuru kiya har task usi din complete kiya, adhoora nahi chhoda.

habits.name: Preparation & Readiness
habits.description: Agle din ke study materials raat ko hi ready kiye.
habits.criteria: Agle din ke study materials raat ko hi ready kiye.

habits.name: Conceptual Understanding
habits.description: Formula/concept ko apne shabdon mein explain kar sake bina dekhe.
habits.criteria: Formula/concept ko apne shabdon mein explain kar sake bina dekhe.

habits.name: Why Thinking
habits.description: Har naye concept pe "ye kyun sach hai" likha.
habits.criteria: Har naye concept pe "ye kyun sach hai" likha.

habits.name: How & What-if Thinking
habits.description: "Ye kaise use hota hai" + ek what-if variation socha.
habits.criteria: "Ye kaise use hota hai" + ek what-if variation socha.

habits.name: Active Recall
habits.description: Bina notes dekhe, kal ka content likh ke test kiya.
habits.criteria: Bina notes dekhe, kal ka content likh ke test kiya.

habits.name: Daily Revision
habits.description: Pichle 3 din ka content ek baar revise kiya.
habits.criteria: Pichle 3 din ka content ek baar revise kiya.

habits.name: Mistake Logging
habits.description: Har mistake dedicated Mistake Log mein likhi.
habits.criteria: Har mistake dedicated Mistake Log mein likhi.

habits.name: Error Analysis
habits.description: Har galat question ka root cause classify kiya.
habits.criteria: Har galat question ka root cause classify kiya.

habits.name: Problem Decomposition
habits.description: Tough question ko chhote steps mein toda before solving.
habits.criteria: Tough question ko chhote steps mein toda before solving.

habits.name: Problem Solving (unseen)
habits.description: Roz min 5 unseen-type questions attempt kiye.
habits.criteria: Roz min 5 unseen-type questions attempt kiye.

habits.name: Logical Thinking
habits.description: Solution ke har step ka reason clear hai.
habits.criteria: Solution ke har step ka reason clear hai.

habits.name: Critical Thinking
habits.description: Apna hi answer verify karne se pehle "ye galat kyun ho sakta hai" socha.
habits.criteria: Apna hi answer verify karne se pehle "ye galat kyun ho sakta hai" socha.

habits.name: Analytical Thinking
habits.description: Solve karne se pehle "ye kis concept se related hai" identify kiya.
habits.criteria: Solve karne se pehle "ye kis concept se related hai" identify kiya.

habits.name: Observation
habits.description: Question ke saare given data pehle carefully note kiye.
habits.criteria: Question ke saare given data pehle carefully note kiye.

habits.name: Detail Awareness
habits.description: Units, signs, conditions miss nahi kiye.
habits.criteria: Units, signs, conditions miss nahi kiye.

habits.name: Pattern Recognition
habits.description: Similar solved questions se pattern connect kiya.
habits.criteria: Similar solved questions se pattern connect kiya.

habits.name: Verification
habits.description: Har solved answer ko alternate method/estimation se verify kiya.
habits.criteria: Har solved answer ko alternate method/estimation se verify kiya.

habits.name: Double Checking
habits.description: Final karne se pehle poora solution ek baar re-read kiya.
habits.criteria: Final karne se pehle poora solution ek baar re-read kiya.

habits.name: Progress Tracking
habits.description: Roz ka completion % note kiya.
habits.criteria: Roz ka completion % note kiya.

habits.name: Performance Review
habits.description: Har mock/test ke baad structured review kiya.
habits.criteria: Har mock/test ke baad structured review kiya.

habits.name: Daily Review (deep)
habits.description: Night review ab 5 questions ka deeper review hai.
habits.criteria: Night review ab 5 questions ka deeper review hai.

habits.name: Weekly Review
habits.description: Har 7th din ek weekly review session hua.
habits.criteria: Har 7th din ek weekly review session hua.

habits.name: Self-Reflection (Month 1)
habits.description: Month 1 Reflection likha: strong habits, weak habits, agle phase ke adjustments.
habits.criteria: Month 1 Reflection likha: strong habits, weak habits, agle phase ke adjustments.

habits.name: Evidence check
habits.description: Pick one weak concept/test mistake and write claim, evidence, and missing proof before studying.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Assumption test on one JEE problem
habits.description: Before solving, list two assumptions and verify them after solution.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Reality review
habits.description: Compare planned vs actual study output and write one correction for tomorrow.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Hypothesis drill for a tough concept
habits.description: Make one why/how hypothesis, test it with notes or solved examples, and record result.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Find one counterexample
habits.description: For a formula/rule, find where it fails or what condition is required.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Assumption log update
habits.description: Log one wrong assumption from today and the corrected version.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: 5-Why root cause on one mistake
habits.description: Use five-whys on one repeated mistake until the real cause is specific.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: One system fix for a recurring miss
habits.description: Create a small checklist/process change that prevents a repeated error.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Feedback loop close-out
habits.description: Review yesterday’s fix and mark whether it reduced the problem.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Derive from first principles
habits.description: Derive one formula/result from definitions instead of memorising it.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Probability estimate before answer
habits.description: Estimate answer range/sign before calculation and compare after solving.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Principle map for a chapter
habits.description: Map one chapter topic to its core laws and common question patterns.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Bias check before judging performance
habits.description: Separate facts from feelings about today’s performance in three bullets.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Independent solution attempt
habits.description: Try one problem fully before looking at hints/solution.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Objective review of a wrong answer
habits.description: Write what data says went wrong: concept, calculation, interpretation, or time.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: One deep why question
habits.description: Ask and answer one deeper why behind a concept connection.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Link two topics
habits.description: Connect two related ideas across chapters/subjects with an example.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Knowledge gap capture
habits.description: Write one gap discovered today and the exact source/action to close it.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Attention reset before study block
habits.description: Do a 60-second reset: desk clear, phone away, target visible.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Question condition scan
habits.description: Underline/list every condition in three problems before solving.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Vigilance review
habits.description: Record one missed condition/sign/unit and prevention cue.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Precision checklist run
habits.description: Run units/signs/boundary checks on today’s toughest solved problem.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Adapt plan from evidence
habits.description: Change one plan item based on latest performance evidence.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Decision log
habits.description: Write one keep/skip decision for tomorrow with reason.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Best/base/worst study scenario
habits.description: Plan today with best/base/worst-case time blocks.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Add buffer for biggest risk
habits.description: Identify biggest schedule risk and add a backup slot.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Scenario review at night
habits.description: Check which scenario happened and what to adjust.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Rank tasks by marks impact
habits.description: Rank today’s tasks by JEE marks impact, not comfort.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Do highest-impact task first
habits.description: Start with the highest-impact task for at least 25 minutes.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Cut one low-value activity
habits.description: Remove or shrink one low-value task/distraction today.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Prepare study resources upfront
habits.description: Keep notes, PYQs, timer, and formula sheet ready before block.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Clean one topic folder/list
habits.description: Organise one chapter’s pending questions/resources into clear buckets.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Resource review
habits.description: Note one missing resource and when you will collect it.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Explain one concept aloud
habits.description: Teach one concept aloud in simple language without notes.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Confidence rep
habits.description: Solve one timed question and write what improved confidence.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Write one precise doubt
habits.description: Frame one doubt with context, attempt, and exact stuck point.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Finish a resistance block
habits.description: Do 20 minutes on the task you most want to avoid.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Commitment check
habits.description: Write why this goal matters and one promise for the next block.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Restart fast after slip
habits.description: If distracted, restart within 2 minutes and log the trigger.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Reframe one weakness as trainable
habits.description: Turn one weak area into a concrete practice plan.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Self-evaluate today honestly
habits.description: Score focus, accuracy, and consistency with one reason each.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: One improvement rep
habits.description: Repeat one previously wrong question/concept and verify improvement.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Label stress before reacting
habits.description: Name the emotion, trigger, and next best action before study.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Two-minute breathing reset
habits.description: Do a calm reset before a mock/revision block.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Pressure review
habits.description: Write how stress affected decisions and one correction.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Sleep plan lock
habits.description: Set bedtime/wakeup and shutdown study 30 minutes before sleep.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Recovery walk/stretch
habits.description: Do 10 minutes walk/stretch to protect energy.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Energy review
habits.description: Rate sleep/energy and adjust tomorrow’s load.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Exam-day protocol rehearsal
habits.description: Rehearse admit-card/material/time/checklist mentally and log gaps.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Final revision only
habits.description: Revise formulae/mistake log; avoid new topics unless critical.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.

habits.name: Lifelong system reflection
habits.description: Write the 3 systems you will keep after this 90-day cycle.
habits.criteria: Complete the daily task and write a short evidence note.
